description: fz-bin.16 exposed a broader compiler gap: the shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge lambda can receive a generic callable-shaped reducer capture when several reducer shapes meet at the runtime function. Native then tries to box a direct-only callable at a callee input publication with no native boundary. fz-bin.16 avoids the bridge for Enum take/drop/split runtime functions, but the generic transport/native correlation should be fixed so direct callable reducer captures survive through shared bridge closures.

comments.text: During fz-bin.16, the original native lowering fatal was traced to direct callable reducer captures flowing through the shared Enum.reduce/3 bridge. The fz-bin.16 runtime path avoids that bridge for take/drop/split, but the generic compiler issue remains: shared bridge callable captures need correlated direct callable shapes instead of falling back to generic callable inputs that native tries to box without a boundary.

title: compiler2 preserves direct callable shapes through shared Enum.reduce bridge captures
